name: Times club monthly special crossword No 20,251

solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: French out of competition over early transit option

indicators.note: in an across clue 'over' asks for the word before it to be turned back to front

blocks.note: hors is the French word for outside, as in hors de combat
a race is a competition

explanation.surface: A French entrant has been withdrawn from a contest about old-fashioned public transport.
explanation.definitionFit: A horsecar was a horse-drawn tram, one of the first forms of public transport in towns.

clue.text: Official staff raise Henry and Maureen informally

indicators.note: in a down clue raising something lifts it so it reads from the bottom upwards

blocks.note: Hal is the familiar form of Henry, as with Shakespeare's Prince Hal
Mo is a pet name for Maureen

explanation.surface: Two named employees get a pay rise as officials ask for staff to be raised.
explanation.walkthrough: 'informally' covers both names: each is cut to its familiar short form before the pair is read upwards.
explanation.definitionFit: In British India the omlah was the body of clerks and native officers attached to a court or government department.

clue.text: American’s watery stew of (I’m thinking) chump eaten by small cat

indicators.note: what is eaten goes inside the eater, so the words before sit inside the cat

blocks.note: S is the standard abbreviation for small
a lion is a big cat
um is the noise a person makes while thinking
a gull is a dupe, someone easily fooled

explanation.surface: A thin stew made from a cut of meat called the chump is being eaten by a little cat.
explanation.walkthrough: Chump looks like a cut of lamb in the stew, but it means a fool, and the bracketed aside is a hesitation noise.
explanation.definitionFit: Slumgullion is American slang for a thin, cheap meat stew, a word from the mining camps.

clue.text: Blue worn by new cook reduced problem in throat

indicators.note: worn here means pierced through, so the colour has a letter driven into its middle
reduced means cut short, so the last letter of the kitchen worker comes off

blocks.note: cyan is a greenish blue
N is the abbreviation for new
a chef is a cook

explanation.surface: A cook in new blue whites has a sore throat that is getting better.
explanation.walkthrough: Worn by reads as clothing, but here the colour is pierced, with the single letter driven into it.
explanation.definitionFit: Cynanche is an old medical term for any inflammatory disease of the throat, such as quinsy or croup.

clue.text: Confusion of inch and yard when checking rustic valley leeches

indicators.note: confusion jumbles the two units of measurement into a new order
checking means holding back or restraining, so the jumbled letters hold the next pair inside them

blocks.note: taken as written
taken as written
a hob is a country fellow, a rustic or clown
a dell is a small wooded valley

explanation.surface: Imperial measurement muddles complicate a survey of a country valley famous for its leeches.
explanation.walkthrough: The jumbled measures split into two parts, front and back, that hold the rustic valley between them.
explanation.definitionFit: Rhynchobdellida is the order of jawless leeches that feed through a proboscis, so the word names a group of leeches.

clue.text: Muslim teacher and king scuttle German agreement

blocks.note: K is the chess abbreviation for king
a hod is a coal scuttle
ja is German for yes

explanation.surface: A teacher and a monarch wreck an accord with Germany.
explanation.walkthrough: Scuttle looks like a verb meaning to sink, but it is the coal bucket.
explanation.definitionFit: A khodja, also spelt hodja or khoja, is a title for a Muslim schoolmaster or learned man.

clue.text: Hookah by another name, mostly secured by knots

indicators.note: mostly means not quite all, so the final letter is dropped
something secured by another thing is held fast inside it

blocks.note: kn is the abbreviation for knots, the nautical speed unit
alias means otherwise known as

explanation.surface: A water pipe known by another name has been tied down with knots.
explanation.walkthrough: Knots looks like rope work, but it is the nautical speed unit, abbreviated.
explanation.definitionFit: A kalian is the Persian water pipe, another word for a hookah or narghile.

clue.text: Rise of Australian native related to us in Perth

indicators.note: in a down clue a rise reads upwards, from the bottom of the light to the top

blocks.note: a roo is a kangaroo, short for the native marsupial

explanation.surface: An Australian native is climbing up a family tree in Perth, Western Australia.
explanation.walkthrough: Perth looks Australian beside the kangaroo, but it is the Perth in Scotland, where oor is the dialect form of our.
explanation.definitionFit: Oor is Scots for our, the possessive meaning belonging or related to us.

clue.text: Introduction of Justice Bill baselessly expresses doubt about revolt

indicators.note: an introduction is the opening part, so just the first letter is kept
in a down clue the base is the bottom letter, and baselessly means without it

blocks.note: the first letter of Justice
AC is short for account, a bill
to query is to express doubt

explanation.surface: A judge introducing a bill without any basis provokes doubts about an uprising.
explanation.walkthrough: QUERIES loses its last letter, the base of a down light.
explanation.definitionFit: The Jacquerie was the French peasant uprising of 1358, and the word has come to mean any peasant revolt.

clue.text: Concealing their ends, everyone prompting adviser to Charlemagne

indicators.note: hiding the ends of both following words means each loses its final letter

blocks.note: all means everyone
cuing an actor is prompting them

explanation.surface: Courtiers hide their purposes while all of them prompt the emperor's counsellor.
explanation.definitionFit: Alcuin of York was the English scholar who served as chief adviser on learning at Charlemagne's court.

clue.text: Very important to restrict string length round bunting

indicators.note: restricting something means hemming it in, so the important word encloses what follows
turning round means facing the other way, so the whole is read backwards

blocks.note: key means crucially important
cord is string
L is the abbreviation for length

explanation.surface: Someone stresses tying a string of a set length around festive flags.
explanation.walkthrough: Bunting looks like flags strung on a line, but it is the bird.
explanation.definitionFit: The yeldrock is a dialect name for the yellowhammer, a member of the bunting family of finch-like birds.

clue.text: Leave Home Secretary to reverse country’s sway

indicators.note: the instruction itself says to turn the preceding words back to front

blocks.note: to go is to leave
HS is the abbreviation for Home Secretary

explanation.surface: A UK interior minister is told to quit and undo a policy that holds sway over the nation.
explanation.walkthrough: The Home Secretary is the British cabinet minister for policing and immigration. Country here means rustic speech, so the definition is a dialect word for sway.
explanation.definitionFit: Shog is a dialect verb meaning to shake, jog or sway from side to side.

clue.text: Sweet tempered raconteuse

indicators.note: tempering metal works it into new shape, so the storyteller's letters are reshaped

blocks.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: A female storyteller is sweet-natured.
explanation.walkthrough: Sweet tempered reads as one phrase about her character; it splits into the definition and the anagram signal.
explanation.definitionFit: Nectareous means like nectar, the sugary liquid of flowers, hence delicious or sugary.

clue.text: Mark of injury, mark that’s painful, in eastern European’s forgotten battle

indicators.note: the marks are placed in between the two single letters that follow

blocks.note: E is the abbreviation for eastern
a scar is the mark left by a wound
M is the abbreviation for the old German mark
ouch is what you say when something hurts
E is the abbreviation for European

explanation.surface: A wounded Eastern European's scars recall an engagement nobody remembers.
explanation.walkthrough: Forgotten signals an obsolete word rather than a deletion.
explanation.definitionFit: Escarmouche is an obsolete English borrowing of the French word for a skirmish, a minor fight.

clue.text: Racket’s target? Thug renouncing a racket

indicators.note: renouncing means giving something up, so the thug's word gives up a letter

blocks.note: a tennis racket is swung at a ball
a yahoo is a brutish lout, from Swift's Gulliver's Travels
taken as written

explanation.surface: A gangster's victim is a thug who has quit the protection business.
explanation.walkthrough: The setter uses racket at both ends on purpose: first the tennis bat whose target is a ball, then the din that is the definition. YAHOO drops its A.
explanation.definitionFit: Ballyhoo is a noisy fuss or uproar, the same sense of racket as din.

clue.text: I can’t digest a superior serving of brandy, say, pub having run out earlier

indicators.note: earlier tells you that what has run out comes first, ahead of the inn

blocks.note: taken as written
U means upper-class, socially superior
a tot is a small measure of a spirit such as brandy
RO is the cricket scorecard abbreviation for run out
PH is the map abbreviation for public house

explanation.surface: Someone who cannot stomach brandy finds the pub has run dry.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition is cryptic: it speaks as the organism itself, which makes its own food rather than digesting other living things.
explanation.definitionFit: An autotroph, like a green plant, builds its nourishment from simple inorganic matter, so it never eats and breaks down prey.

clue.text: Dress to the left, nearly showing basket of mine?

indicators.note: nearly means not quite whole, so the last letter goes
moving leftwards in an across clue means reading from right to left

blocks.note: a frock is a dress

explanation.surface: A shop window displays a dress turned to the left, showing off someone's basket.
explanation.walkthrough: The question mark marks the pun: mine looks like the possessive but means a coal mine.
explanation.definitionFit: A corf is the basket or tub once used to haul coal up a mine shaft.

clue.text: After British aid, India supports old city, providing some local food

indicators.note: in a down clue what supports something sits underneath it

blocks.note: B is the abbreviation for British
help is aid
Ur is the ancient city of Mesopotamia
I is India in the NATO phonetic alphabet

explanation.surface: British aid money props up an ancient city in India and provides food for the locals.
explanation.walkthrough: Local here means of the Indian setting the surface paints.
explanation.definitionFit: Bhelpuri is an Indian street snack of puffed rice, chutney and fried noodles, so it is food local to India.

clue.text: Decorated case recalled in lawsuit evidence

indicators.note: in points only to the letters at the join of the two words, so everything else in them is dropped
recalled means called back, so the letters are taken from right to left

blocks.note: taken as written; only its tail end is kept
taken as written; only its opening letter is kept

explanation.surface: An ornamented box is brought back as evidence in a court case.
explanation.walkthrough: This looks like a setter's error: the letters at the join of the two words, read backwards, give ETIU, with the T and U swapped, so the definition and crossings must settle ETUI.
explanation.definitionFit: An etui is a small ornamental case for needles, scissors or cosmetics, often richly decorated.

clue.text: Adviser against imitating the past, the man had backtracked

indicators.note: backtracking means going back the way one came, so everything is read from the end

blocks.note: retro styles imitate the past
he is the man
'd is the contraction of had

explanation.surface: A counsellor warns against harking back to old ways, since the man had retreated.
explanation.definitionFit: To dehort is to urge someone not to do something, so a dehorter is one who dissuades.

clue.text: Domestic office covering reservation reared antelope

indicators.note: a horse that rears rises up, so in a down clue the word reads upwards
the room covers or wraps around the other piece

blocks.note: a den is a study, a room at home for working in
rez is American slang for a Native American reservation

explanation.surface: A home office hides a reservation for a wild animal raised there.
explanation.definitionFit: The dzeren is the Mongolian gazelle, an antelope of the Central Asian steppes.

clue.text: See many in the mirror injecting an ounce that enhances athletic performance

indicators.note: a mirror shows things the wrong way round
injecting puts something inside, here into the mirrored letters

blocks.note: lo is an old word for look or see
lots means many
taken as written
oz is the abbreviation for ounce

explanation.surface: An athlete sees plenty of needle marks in the mirror after injecting a performance booster.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition is a descriptive phrase standing in for the noun: something that boosts sport results.
explanation.definitionFit: Stanozolol is an anabolic steroid, banned in sport because it builds muscle and boosts performance.

clue.text: Excessive indulgence of almost the first couple in Dorian Gray

indicators.note: nearly the opening pair: the name is cut down to the two letters sitting one step along from its start

blocks.note: the hero's first name, taken as written
Gy is the symbol for the gray, the SI unit of absorbed radiation dose

explanation.surface: Debauchery is the theme of Wilde's novel about Dorian Gray, whose portrait ages while he indulges.
explanation.walkthrough: Gray looks like part of the hero's name, but it is the scientific unit, written as its symbol.
explanation.definitionFit: An orgy is a bout of unrestrained indulgence, whether in feasting, drinking or sex.

clue.text: Forced exile is to saturate surrounding area

indicators.note: surrounding means enclosing, so the flooding word goes round the next one

blocks.note: to glut is to fill to excess
A is the abbreviation for area

explanation.surface: Banishment is like flooding the whole neighbourhood.
explanation.definitionFit: Galut is the Hebrew term for the Jewish diaspora, the enforced exile of Jews from their homeland.

clue.text: For old tragedian, boots banal stuff around day one

indicators.note: around means encircling, so the dull material goes about the day

blocks.note: corn is trite, sentimental material
Thu is the abbreviation for Thursday
I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: Footwear wrapped in dull padding is put on for a classical actor at the start of the day.
explanation.definitionFit: Cothurni are the thick-soled buskins worn by actors in ancient Greek tragedy.

clue.text: Elevation of God in Rastafarianism or Islamic expectation

indicators.note: in a down clue elevating something lifts it so it reads upwards

blocks.note: Jah is the Rastafarian name for God

explanation.surface: Raising God up is a hope shared by two different faiths.
explanation.definitionFit: The haj is the pilgrimage to Mecca that every able Muslim is expected to make once in a lifetime.

clue.text: Perhaps rustle from aged subordinate officer stops during the last month

indicators.note: something that stops a gap is plugged into it, during that span

blocks.note: ult, short for ultimo, means last month
an NCO is a non-commissioned officer

explanation.surface: An elderly sergeant's horse-thieving is halted in the closing month.
explanation.walkthrough: From aged marks the word as archaic; rustle is the horse-thief's verb, offered as an example.
explanation.definitionFit: Shakespeare's uncolt means to take a horse from someone, and rustling steals horses or cattle.

clue.text: Note a vaccination involving hospital about which Hindus sing

indicators.note: involving means taking in, so the injection takes in the hospital letter
about can mean turned around, so the whole run reads backwards

blocks.note: N is short for note
taken as written
a jab is an injection
H is the map symbol for hospital

explanation.surface: A note about a hospital vaccination, which prompts worshippers to sing.
explanation.definitionFit: A bhajan is a Hindu devotional song or hymn sung at worship.

clue.text: Cordial missive from Folketing possibly avoiding extremes

indicators.note: avoiding the extremes means leaving out the first and last letters of each word

blocks.note: the Folketing is the parliament of Denmark, so its output is Danish
a missive is a letter

explanation.surface: A warm letter arrives from the Danish parliament.
explanation.walkthrough: Cordial looks like an adjective for the friendly letter, but it is the drink.
explanation.definitionFit: Anisette is a sweet liqueur flavoured with aniseed, and a cordial is such a sweet alcoholic drink.
